q1.explanationZh: qualify 的名词形式是 qualification“资格”。

q2.explanationZh: qualified 形容词“有资格的；胜任的”，be qualified for“胜任……”。

q3.explanationZh: qualify 动词“使具有资格；使胜任”，注意结尾是 -ify。

q4.explanationZh: quality 名词“质量；品质”，注意与 quantity“数量”区分。

q5.explanationZh: quantity 名词“数量”，注意与 quality“质量”区分。

q6.explanationZh: quarrel 可作动词和名词“争吵”，quarrel with sb.“和某人吵架”。

q7.explanationZh: quarter“四分之一；一刻钟”，a quarter to seven“差一刻七点”。

q8.explanationZh: queen“女王；王后”，注意中间是双写 e。

q9.explanationZh: question 名词“问题”，动词“询问；审问”。

q10.explanationZh: queue“排队”，拼写是 q-u-e-u-e，读音和字母 Q 一样。

q11.explanationZh: quick 形容词“快的”，口语中也可作副词；加 -ly 构成副词 quickly。

q12.explanationZh: quiet 形容词“安静的”，也可作动词“（使）安静”；注意与 quite 拼写不同。

q13.explanationZh: quit 动词“停止；放弃；辞职”，加 -ing 时双写 t：quitting。

q14.explanationZh: quite 副词“十分；相当”，结尾是 -ite，注意与 quiet 区分。

q15.explanationZh: quiz 名词“测验”，复数是 quizzes（双写 z）。

q16.explanationZh: quote 动词“引用”，名词形式是 quotation。

q18.explanationZh: race 有两个同形词：“赛跑；比赛”和“人种；种族”，拼写相同。

q19.explanationZh: race“种族”去 e 加 -ial 构成形容词 racial“种族的”。

q20.explanationZh: radar“雷达”，正着读倒着读都一样。

q21.explanationZh: radiation 名词“辐射”，以 -tion 结尾。

q22.explanationZh: radio“收音机；无线电”，复数直接加 -s：radios。

q24.explanationZh: radium“镭”，化学元素名，以 -ium 结尾。

q25.explanationZh: rail“铁路；铁轨；栏杆”，by rail“乘火车”。

q27.explanationZh: rain 可作动词“下雨”和名词“雨”。

q30.explanationZh: rain 加 -y 构成形容词 rainy“下雨的”，rainy season“雨季”。

q31.explanationZh: raise 是及物动词“举起；养育；筹集”，后面要接宾语；不及物的“升起”用 rise。

q32.explanationZh: quote 是及物动词，直接接宾语：quote one’s words“引用某人的话”。

q33.explanationZh: by rail“乘火车”，by 后面的交通方式不加冠词。

q34.explanationZh: qualification for...“……的资格（证明）”，介词用 for。

q35.explanationZh: qualified 形容词“合格的”，放在名词 doctor 前作定语。

q37.explanationZh: keep 是系动词，后接形容词 quiet：keep quiet“保持安静”。

q38.explanationZh: have a quiz“进行一次测验”，quiz 是可数名词。

q39.explanationZh: at random“随机地；随意地”，介词用 at。

q42.explanationZh: raise up“举起”，raise 本身就有“举起”的意思。

q43.explanationZh: range from A to B“范围从 A 到 B”，range 作动词表示“（在一定范围内）变动”。

q44.explanationZh: in a queue“排着队”，如 stand in a queue“排队”。

q45.explanationZh: be qualified for sth.“胜任某事；有资格做某事”，介词用 for。

q46.explanationZh: the quality of sth.“某物的质量”。

q47.explanationZh: “爸爸给我买了一件……”，a 后接单数名词，raincoat“雨衣”。

q49.explanationZh: 修饰名词 manager 要用形容词，qualified“合格的”。

q50.explanationZh: 此地受到放射线污染，radioactivity“放射性”。

q51.explanationZh: rain 作及物动词“使如雨下”，rain blows on sb.“雨点般地打向某人”；这里是现在分词作伴随状语，用 raining。

q52.explanationZh: has 后用过去分词构成现在完成时，race against“和……比赛”→ raced。

q53.explanationZh: approve of 中 of 是介词，后接动名词；quit 双写 t 加 -ing → quitting“辞去”。

q54.explanationZh: all the colours of the rainbow“彩虹的所有颜色”，即“五彩缤纷”。

q55.explanationZh: listen to the radio“听广播”，这是固定搭配。

q56.explanationZh: 修饰形容词 useful 用副词 quite“很，相当”；注意不要写成 quiet。

q57.sampleAnswer: We’ll have a quiz at the end of class.
references: We’ll have a quiz at the end of class.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q57.explanationZh: “进行一次测试”= have a quiz；“下课前”可译为 at the end of class。

q58.sampleAnswer: Today’s children are raised in a way that is totally different from how their parents were brought up.
references: Today’s children are raised in a way that is totally different from how their parents were brought up.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: raise 表示“养育”，孩子是被养育的，用被动语态 are raised；“与……截然不同”= be totally different from。

q59.sampleAnswer: Among the boys, Tom is the quickest to learn new things.
references: Among the boys, Tom is the quickest to learn new things.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: 在三者以上中比较用最高级 the quickest；“学得最快”= the quickest to learn。

q60.sampleAnswer: Every morning he spent two hours training for the race.
references: Every morning he spent two hours training for the race.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “花时间做某事”= spend time doing sth.；“为比赛训练”= train for the race。

q61.sampleAnswer: The development of high-speed railway has made it more convenient for us to travel around.
references: The development of high-speed railway has made it more convenient for us to travel around.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “高速铁路”= high-speed railway；make it + adj. + for sb. to do 中 it 是形式宾语。

q62.sampleAnswer: It was the heavy rain that prevented the sports meeting from being held as scheduled.
references: It was the heavy rain that prevented the sports meeting from being held as scheduled.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: 用强调句 It was...that... 强调原因；“大雨”= heavy rain；“阻止……做”= prevent...from doing；“如期”= as scheduled。

q63.sampleAnswer: People had to stand in a queue for hours to buy a ticket.
references: People had to stand in a queue for hours to buy a ticket.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “排队”= stand in a queue；“得”用 had to；“几个小时”= for hours。

q64.sampleAnswer: Don’t always quarrel with others, and learn how to get along well with people around you.
references: Don’t always quarrel with others, and learn how to get along well with people around you.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “和某人争吵”= quarrel with sb.；“与……相处”= get along well with；两个祈使句用 and 连接。

q65.sampleAnswer: Serious quality problems exist in the electronic product and few customers show interest in it.
references: Serious quality problems exist in the electronic product and few customers show interest in it.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “质量问题”= quality problems；“几乎没有”用 few；“对……感兴趣”= show interest in。

q66.sampleAnswer: Whatever questions the students may ask, the teacher would answer them with patience.
references: Whatever questions the students may ask, the teacher would answer them with patience.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “不管什么”= whatever，后接名词 questions；“耐心地”= with patience。
